description: Known-good tokens-per-second floor per (accelerator_type x model). Layer 4 of the GPU-integrity plan: shepherd-node periodically runs a small synthetic prompt against a currently-resident model and measures real-world tok/s. If the measured rate falls below the tier floor, that's a latency-regression signal — distinct from Layer 3's cross-source verification (which catches 'GPU passthrough lost'); this catches 'GPU still nominally working but suddenly slow'.

nvidia._note: Baselines captured from cluster-llm RTX 3090 Ti on 2026-05-16. Mid-range/low-end NVIDIA GPUs will run below these; tier-by-card-class is a v2 refinement.

intel-arc._note: Phoenix Arc is currently CPU-falling-back per Phoenix Arc backlog. Baselines pending kernel/ipex-llm regression resolution.

intel-iris._note: Lab nodes + nuk1 with integrated Iris graphics. Lower expected throughput than discrete Arc.

qwen2.5:1.5b.captured_on: lab nodes once Iris path is verified

amd._note: No AMD herd peers yet. Slot in baselines when first AMD node joins.

apple-silicon._note: No Apple Silicon herd peers yet.

cpu._note: CPU-only inference; no Layer 4 baseline check applies. CPU throughput is highly variable per-host and per-model and isn't a regression signal in itself.
